name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Utensil Holder with Bottle Opener
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and durable metal hardware, offering a sturdy, rustic, and functional display finish.
    - Features a 1-layer wooden construction with 5mm thickness, providing solid support and long-lasting durability.
    - Includes a built-in metal bottle opener for added convenience and everyday practicality.
    - Comes with multiple bronze single hooks for hanging utensils, keys, or small accessories neatly.
    - Designed with wall-mount hardware compatibility and includes screws and anchors for secure installation.
    - Combines decorative charm with practical storage and bottle-opening functionality in one piece.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
               +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
               +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
               +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
    - Bottle opener size: 6.2 x 7.9 cm
    - Bronze single hook size: 1.3 x 4.2 cm
    - Supports up to 5 hooks
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    -  Features single-sided printing on the product.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a decorative wall sign, utensil holder, and built-in bottle opener.
    - Designed to help organize small kitchen tools, grilling accessories, keys, or lightweight hanging items.
    - Suitable for kitchens, bars, patios, BBQ corners, garages, or man cave décor.
    - Wall-mounted design helps save space while keeping useful items easy to access.
    - Perfect for combining storage, decoration, and bottle-opening convenience in one personalized piece.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, husbands, grandpas, brothers, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarmings, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for BBQ lovers, grill masters, home bar fans, and anyone who enjoys rustic personalized décor.
    - A thoughtful gift for kitchens, patios, garages, and entertainment spaces.
    - Great for holiday gifting, family name signs, and practical decorative keepsakes.
    - Adds a warm, fun, and functional touch to any personal space🎁

 

  • Installation Instructions:
    - Step 1: Choose a suitable wall location and mark the mounting points.
    - Step 2: Drill holes if needed and insert the included anchors into the wall.
    - Step 3: Secure the wooden holder to the wall using the included screws.
    - Step 4: Check that the product is mounted firmly and evenly before use.
    - Step 5: Hang utensils or small accessories on the hooks and use the bottle opener as needed.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Utensil Holder with Bottle Opener

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
